LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Writing 3.5 Guided Writing (1 lesson) • Vocabulary and language use By the end o
Topic 3.6: Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing, part of Writing 3.5 Guided Writing (1 lesson) • Vocabulary and language use By the end o in Grade 7 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: Why is writing legibly and neatly important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. use the appropriate punctuation in sentences,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Guided Writing in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. write simple paragraphs related to the given themes,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Guided Writing in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. justify the importance of writing legibly for effective communication.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Guided Writing in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. look at the given texts and collaboratively highlight the punctuation marks used,
2. collaborate writing a short text about the places

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: teamwork skills are developed when the learner collaboratively highlights the punctuation

marks used in the texts.

Values:
Unity: the learner displays team spirit while forming sentences on the given measure words with peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion is enhanced as the learner works harmoniously and cooperatively with peers to write and punctuate texts

appropriately.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner links their learning to Mathematics on the concept of using numbers in giving accurate quantities of items.
